mapper.select: select id, scope, topic_id, scene_key, drop_type, weight, param_json, status, create_time from reward_drop_rule where status = 1 and (weight is not null and weight > 0) and ( scope = 0 or (scope = 1 and topic_id = #{topicId}) or (scope = 2 and scene_key = #{sceneKey}) )
select id, scope, topic_id, scene_key, drop_type, weight, param_json, status, create_time from reward_drop_rule where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into reward_drop_rule (scope, topic_id, scene_key, drop_type, weight, param_json, status) values (#{scope}, #{topicId}, #{sceneKey}, #{dropType}, #{weight}, #{paramJson}, #{status})
